title: PingCAP / TiDB Cloud
description: [AI generated] PingCAP is a technology company founded in 2015 in Beijing, China, specializing in distributed database software. It develops TiDB, an open-source, MySQL-compatible distributed SQL database designed for hybrid transactional and analytical processing. Its cloud offering, TiDB Cloud, provides fully managed database-as-a-service on major cloud platforms. The company operates globally, serving enterprises in finance, gaming, e-commerce, and software industries requiring scalable data solutions.
